We ran the multi-group ctwas with parameters: L=5, shared_all, thin=1

The GWAS we used: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35379992/

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(ctwas)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

gwas_n <- 487511
outputdir <- "/project/xinhe/xsun/AD_jubao/3.ctwas/output"
qtl_types <- c("caQTL", "eQTL")

plot_piechart_topn <- function(ctwas_parameters, colors, by, title, n_tissue = 5) {
  data <- data.frame(
    category = names(ctwas_parameters$prop_heritability),
    percentage = ctwas_parameters$prop_heritability
  )

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      context = sub("\\|.*", "", category),
      type = sub(".*\\|", "", category)
    )

  if (by == "type") {
    data <- data %>%
      group_by(type) %>%
      summarize(percentage = sum(percentage)) %>%
      mutate(category = type)
  } else if (by == "context") {
    data <- data %>%
      group_by(context) %>%
      summarize(percentage = sum(percentage)) %>%
      mutate(category = context)
  } else if (by == "category") {
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(category = ifelse(category == "SNP", "SNP", category))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid 'by' parameter. Use 'type', 'context', or 'category'.")
  }

  data$percentage_label <- paste0(round(data$percentage * 100, 2), "%")

  if (nrow(data) > (n_tissue + 1)) {
    data <- data %>%
      filter(context != "SNP") %>%
      arrange(desc(percentage)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      mutate(context = ifelse(rank <= 5, context, "Other_Tissues")) %>%
      group_by(context) %>%
      summarise(percentage = sum(percentage), .groups = "drop") %>%
      bind_rows(data %>% filter(context == "SNP") %>% select(context, percentage)) %>%
      mutate(
        category = context,
        percentage_label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", percentage * 100), "%")
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(percentage))

    sorted_levels <- data %>%
      mutate(sort_key = case_when(
        category == "Other_Tissues" ~ 1,
        category == "SNP" ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 0
      )) %>%
      arrange(sort_key, desc(percentage)) %>%
      pull(category)
  } else {
    sorted_levels <- data %>%
      arrange((category == "SNP"), desc(percentage)) %>%
      pull(category)
  }

  data$category <- factor(data$category, levels = sorted_levels)

  data <- data %>%
    arrange(category) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative = cumsum(percentage),
      midpoint = cumulative - percentage / 2
    )

  categories <- levels(data$category)
  has_snp <- "SNP" %in% categories
  other_cats <- setdiff(categories, "SNP")

  color_vec <- c()
  if (has_snp) {
    color_vec["SNP"] <- "#fbf6ef"
  }

  if (length(other_cats) > 0) {
    if (is.null(names(colors))) {
      colors_other <- rep(colors, length.out = length(other_cats))
      color_vec <- c(color_vec, setNames(colors_other, other_cats))
    } else {
      for (cat in other_cats) {
        color_vec[cat] <- ifelse(cat %in% names(colors), colors[cat], "#c9cba3")
      }
    }
  }

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      y_pos = midpoint,
      angle = 0,
      left_side = midpoint > 0.5,
      hjust = ifelse(left_side, 1, 0)
    )

  pie <- ggplot(data, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    theme_void() +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(y = 1 - y_pos, label = percentage_label, angle = angle),
      size = 3,
      nudge_x = 0.8,
      segment.size = 0.3,
      segment.color = "gray40",
      box.padding = 0.2,
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_vec) +
    labs(fill = "") +
    ggtitle(title)

  return(pie)
}
```

# caQTL

```{r caQTL-load}
param_caQTL <- readRDS(file.path(outputdir, "caQTL", "AD.caQTL.param.shared_all.RDS"))
```

## Convergence

```{r caQTL-convergence, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
make_convergence_plots(param_caQTL, gwas_n)
```

## Parameters and Enrichment

```{r caQTL-param}
ctwas_param_caQTL <- summarize_param(param_caQTL, gwas_n, enrichment_test = "fisher")
ctwas_param_caQTL
```

## Heritability Pie Chart

```{r caQTL-piechart, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot_piechart_topn(ctwas_param_caQTL,
                   colors = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9"),
                   by = "category",
                   title = "caQTL - Percent of Heritability (PVE)")
```

# eQTL

```{r eQTL-load}
param_eQTL <- readRDS(file.path(outputdir, "eQTL", "AD.eQTL.param.shared_all.RDS"))
```

## Convergence

```

ctwas_param_eQTL
```

## Heritability Pie Chart
